title: LinkedIn Jobs Scraper Input
description: Search by keywords and locations, paste complete LinkedIn Jobs search URLs to preserve every filter, or scrape individual public job URLs. Start with 1-5 results and Residential proxy.

searchUrls.title: LinkedIn Jobs Search URLs
searchUrls.description: Optional full linkedin.com/jobs/search URLs. Existing LinkedIn filters are preserved and paginated automatically.

jobUrls.title: Individual LinkedIn Job URLs
jobUrls.description: Optional public linkedin.com/jobs/view URLs for direct job-detail extraction.

keywords.title: Job Keywords
keywords.description: Job titles, skills, or search terms. Use together with locations.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: City, region, or country. Use together with keywords.

datePosted.title: Date Posted
datePosted.description: Filter jobs by how recently LinkedIn posted them.

easyApplyOnly.title: Easy Apply Only
easyApplyOnly.description: Only return jobs marked with LinkedIn Easy Apply.

sortBy.title: Sort Results
sortBy.description: Sort keyword searches by relevance or newest first.

minimumSalary.title: Minimum Salary
minimumSalary.description: Optional LinkedIn salary threshold. Availability and currency depend on the selected market.

maxResults.title: Max Results (total)
maxResults.description: Maximum number of jobs to scrape across all searches

maxJobsPerSearch.title: Max Jobs Per Search
maxJobsPerSearch.description: Maximum jobs to scrape per keyword + location combination

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy settings (residential recommended for LinkedIn)
